title: DeepSeek V4 Flash 0731 — B12X + DSpark (eugr recipe)
author: eugr/spark-vllm-docker (MIT licence) — snapshot of 2026-09-28, run by the TwinSpark maintainers

measured.context: max-model-len auto → 1,048,576 tokens on two DGX Sparks

requirements: Local image vllm-node-b12x on BOTH nodes, built with eugr/spark-vllm-docker (`./build-and-copy.sh --exp-b12x` builds it and copies it to the other node). Pin uses the local image ID and checks it is identical on both nodes.
Mod instanttensor-hybrid-draft-loader on both nodes: `tsm mods import-eugr <your spark-vllm-docker checkout>/mods --only instanttensor-hybrid-draft-loader`.
Weights deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 (~155 GiB) on both nodes: staged on the first activation, or reused from your Hugging Face cache.
notes: The recipe text is eugr's, as published on 2026-09-28 (it has changed upstream since; import the current one from the Cookbook's community recipes). TwinSpark only replaces the host/port wiring and adds the NCCL/RoCE settings from controller.yaml.
If the model was started with eugr's launcher before, stop its vllm_node containers before the first TwinSpark activation (Diagnostics → foreign containers).
